LanguageData.CC_Election_Unbeaten: Not once has a vote gone against {PAWN_nameDef}, and this year was no different.
LanguageData.CC_Annals_OpeningAnnalist: The year {0} is over, and {PAWN_nameDef}, who has kept the colony's annals for years now, has written it down in the same careful hand.
LanguageData.CC_Scen_Foe_feud: {FACTION} and the tribe have been at feud since before anyone here was born, and {FOE_nameDef}, who leads their war bands, has sworn to finish it with {VICTIM_nameDef}.
LanguageData.CC_Scen_Foe_Vendetta: {VICTIM_nameDef} has sworn vengeance on {FACTION} for {KIN}, killed in the last raid on the old camp.
LanguageData.CC_ScenPart_Foe_feud: Rimfolk: a neighbouring people the colonists have been at feud with for generations.
LanguageData.CC_Scen_Hunt_feud_Text: {FACTION} have come for the colony again. The old feud goes on, on {FOE}'s word.
LanguageData.CC_Scen_Hunt_feud_Led_Text: {FOE} is leading {FACTION}'s war band against the colony in person, to settle the old feud the old way.
LanguageData.CC_Scen_SecretShared: {NAMES} came down with one secret between them, and swore never to speak of it. {KEEPER_nameDef} carries most of its weight. Whoever comes to live here later won't know, unless one of them lets it slip.
LanguageData.CC_Scen_Seats: The council was named before the colony set out, and sits from the first day: {SEATS}. The colony votes again when the year turns.
LanguageData.CC_Scen_Seats_Eldest: By the old custom the eldest sits with the council from the first day: {SEATS}. The colony will choose for itself once it has grown.
LanguageData.CC_ScenPart_Seats_eldest: Rimfolk: the eldest sits with the council from the first day ({0}).
LanguageData.CC_Scen_Days: They brought their own days with them, and the calendar keeps them as traditions from the first year: {DAYS}. Letting one pass will be felt.
LanguageData.CC_ScenPart_Days: Rimfolk: the colony brings days of its own ({0}).
LanguageData.CC_Scen_Goal: {PAWN_nameDef} came with {PAWN_possessive} heart set on one thing: to {GOAL}.
LanguageData.CC_ScenPart_Goal: Rimfolk: someone came with a life goal ({0}).
LanguageData.CC_Scen_Beholden_granted_Lord: The colony holds this land by grant of {FACTION}, in the name of {LORD}. A grant is not a gift.
LanguageData.CC_Scen_Beholden_granted: The colony holds this land by grant of {FACTION}. A grant is not a gift.
LanguageData.CC_Scen_Beholden_Remembered: {FACTION} have written it down, and one day they will ask for something in return. What the colony says then will be remembered.
LanguageData.CC_ScenPart_Beholden: Rimfolk: the colony holds its land by another people's grant, and owes them for it.
LanguageData.CC_Memory_Deed_granted_Name: granted the colony its land, in {NAME}'s name
LanguageData.CC_Scen_Wards: {CARERS} brought {COUNT} children out with them: {NAMES}. None of them has anyone else in the world.
LanguageData.CC_ScenPart_Wards: Rimfolk: {0}-{1} children in the colony's care, with nobody else (Biotech).
LanguageData.CC_Scen_Hint_ShipDown: The ship won't stay in orbit for long. When it comes down, half the region will be picking through the wreck, and through whatever it was carrying.
LanguageData.CC_Scen_Hint_Orphanage: Word travels that there are children here. A storyteller or a troupe of players will find their way to the gate before long, and so might a child who is lost.
LanguageData.CC_Scen_Hint_Steward: The lord's reeve will come round to see how the grant is being worked, and what it owes, sooner rather than later.
